root_idea.summary: A root orientation involving melting or dissolving, flowing, and creeping movement, extended by analogy to consuming anxiety and to an intention formed in the mind.
root_idea.development: From concrete imagery of melting, flowing, and creeping, the lexicon develops senses of anxiety as something that dissolves or consumes, intention as what is held in the mind, and related terms for aspiration, old age, difficulty, and importance.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed as the normalized Form IV perfect citation form.

senses.definition: To intend, purpose, or desire to do something; to be minded or resolved toward an act.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for an inward inclination or purpose and, with constructions such as hamma bi- and hamma an-, for being about to undertake an act. The intention may remain unrealized; Quranic contexts range from inclination and desire to firm resolve or plotting.

senses.definition: To cause anxiety, disquiet, or grief; to make someone troubled or preoccupied.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive. In the Quranic construction at 3:154, a person's own self is the source of the anxiety or preoccupation affecting them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a thing, to threaten to fall or to be on the point of occurring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive construction, exemplified as said of a wall threatening to fall.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disquiet or trouble someone; to cause care or anxiety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I usage distinct from the Quran-attested Form IV causative entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be anxious, disquieted, or grieved by an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Typically used with an affair or matter as the cause of the distress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attend to, undertake, manage, or care for an affair or person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may express practical attention, supervision, care, or regard rather than distress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To explore or scour a country.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction used with a place or country.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Purpose or intention; an initial or, in some usage, a strong determination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may mark the beginning of resolve or a more settled resolution, according to the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An object or thing intended, meant, desired, or determined upon in the mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the intended object or aim, not only for the mental state of intending.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anxiety, care, distress, sorrow, or trouble of mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often described as distress arising from harm or annoyance expected to happen; some authorities distinguish this prospective distress from غَمٌّ, while others treat the two as equivalent.
Attested in the idiomatic expression هَمَّكَ مَا هَمَّكَ, meaning what concerns or troubles you.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a reported usage, to melt someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported lexical use with brief attestation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A decrepit, old, weak, or extremely aged man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine counterpart is given as هِمَّةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Purpose, aspiration, enterprise, or ambition, especially high ambition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can denote a firmly rooted drive toward elevated aims and away from base ones.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An aspiring ruler or a magnanimous, courageous, and liberal chief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A laudatory personal designation associated with aspiration and high-minded leadership.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wild bird of the crow kind.
A venomous or noxious creeping creature, especially a scorpion or serpent; also, tropically, a louse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may cover noxious reptiles and similar creeping creatures; its application to a louse is described as tropical.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A difficult, arduous, distressing, or important affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural مُهِمَّاتٌ denotes difficult or important affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Described as dissolving or melting, specifically of hailstones.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported specialized description in the phrase بَرَدٌ مُنْهَمٌّ; the attestation is presented as approximate.

lane_unit_coverage.note: General Form I intention and purpose.
Intending an act without necessarily doing it is covered by the Quranic intention sense.
Intending or desiring an affair is covered by the Quranic intention sense.
Mental purpose or determination is covered by the Quranic intention sense.
Being about or ready to act is covered by the intention-to-act construction.
Pointer-only reference to a verse elsewhere.
Care or regard is covered by the attention meaning.
Strong determination is included as a degree of the nominal intention sense.
Illustrative phrase combining already represented object and anxiety senses.
Two distinct reported uses of هَمَّكَ.
Lexical designation for an extremely aged man.
High ambition is included in the aspiration meaning.
Synonymic expansion of the same lexical branch.

cautions: Lane's supplied material is indexed under the contracted root هم, while the canonical QAC root is the geminate root همم.
The Form I Quranic translations vary from inclination and desire to determination and plotting, but the lexical evidence supports one intention-to-act branch rather than separate senses.
The مُنْهَمٌّ hailstone description is retained as a reported, apparently tentative Classical usage.
